crossRefs.note: “ ‘Moreover you shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death. He shall surely be put to death.

translations.web: But if any harm follows, then you must take life for life,
translations.bsb: But if a serious injury results, then you must require a life for a life—
translations.kjv: And if any mischief follow, then thou shalt give life for life,
translations.asv: But if any harm follow, then thou shalt give life for life,
